page.overview:
Who is Shinjuro Rengoku?

Shinjuro is a tall man with a muscular build, fair skin, bushy black eyebrows. He has bright orange eyes that redden near his white pupils. His eyes are slanted inwards and shaped to give him a furious appearance. He possessing unruly orange hair that flares out around his face, becoming redder near the ends above his ears, that he wears messily tied back behind his head. When he was younger and a more active father, Shinjuro notably cut his hair much shorter. Shinjuro strongly resembled his two sons, Kyojuro and Senjuro in terms of appearances. In fact, despite his gruffer and aged appearance, Shinjuro's resemblance to his elder son was so strong that Kyojuro was mistaken for his father on two separate occasions.

Shinjuro wears a dark grey kimono robe that fades to darker blue from the top, tied with a black obi, and wearing pair of [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Z%C5%8Dri zori]. When Kyojuro informed him of his promotion to Hashira, he wore a beige kimono. In the Infinity Castle Arc, he is shown with a katana with a flame guard similar to Kyojuro's, with what appears to be a flame pattern on the sheath.

When he was the Flame Hashira, Shinjuro donned a brick-colored kimono, dark tattsuke-hakama pants, and a pair of red kyahan decorated with yellow flame motifs. He also wore the haori with flame-like ridges at the end that Kyojuro wore when he was the Flame Hashira.

Shinjuro was a very short-tempered man, especially when regarding the Demon Slayer Corps and his son, Kyojuro, with the mention of either causing him to grow furious. He appeared to be abusive, harshly insulting the recently deceased Kyojuro and knocking Senjuro to the ground during his fight with Tanjiro. He is also an alcoholic - his first action upon awakening after being knocked out by Tanjiro is to buy alcohol, and he is often seen drinking with sake. In fact, it's possible that the worst of Shinjuro's abuse was due to his inebriation.
